A specialized, timely and accessible approach defines our services:
• Structuring of investments with a multi-country approach
• Initial assessment
• Support in capital-raising processes
• Protection of personal data
• Cybersecurity
• Intellectual property

Mexico’s venture capital market is increasingly dynamic. The unique characteristics of this industry require specialized, timely, and accessible advice that allows new entrepreneurs to understand how to structure their investments and plan exits in advance. At Muñoz Manzo y Ocampo, we have extensive experience advising these types of ventures, guiding them with agility and clarity to meet their needs.
